title: Flutter Build
description: Builds or serves a Flutter application (web, APK, or iOS).

env.description: Environment (dev, uat, prod or a custom one): environments/<envProject>/environment.<env>.json is passed with --dart-define-from-file; the build fails when it is missing.

envProject.description: Folder under environments/ with this app's env files and .htaccess sources. Default: the project name.

htaccess.description: Web builds: copy environments/<envProject>/htaccess.<env> into the output as .htaccess; the build fails before it starts when that file is missing, and any other .htaccess is removed. false: no .htaccess. Ignored for apk / ios.

dist.description: Output directory (relative to repo root). Required for non-serve builds.

baseHref.description: URL base href for Flutter web (e.g. /flutter-app/).

serve.description: Run flutter run in web-server mode instead of building.

port.description: Port of the web server when serving.

obfuscate.description: Enable Dart obfuscation for APK / iOS builds (ignored for web).

stripExif.description: Web builds: remove EXIF from the images in dist (only images that have EXIF are rewritten). Set false to leave the output as Flutter wrote it. Ignored for apk / ios.

secure.description: Web builds: write the CSP nonce placeholder into the served index.html (and the other nonce.files), as Angular release builds do. Ignored for apk / ios.

nonce.description: secure: how the nonce placeholder is written. Defaults keep the standard markup; set them to match an existing server setup.

placeholder.description: What the server replaces per request. Default: <!--#echo var="CSP_NONCE" --> (what pstack csp configures).

tags.description: all (default): every script, style and stylesheet link. legacy: inline scripts (no src), every link and every style. every: every script, link and style.

position.description: Where the nonce attribute goes in a tag (default end).

replaceTokens.description: Text replaced by the placeholder anywhere in the page, e.g. ["random-csp-nonce"]. The build fails when a token sits in quotes the placeholder also uses.

ngCspNonce.description: Tag name of the Angular root element (e.g. app-root) that gets ngCspNonce="<placeholder>"; Angular 16+ puts that nonce on the <style> elements it adds at runtime. Default: none.

files.description: Pages to rewrite, relative to the served root (default ["index.html"]); never under assets/.

stripHtmlComments.description: Web builds: remove HTML comments from index.html (and the other nonce.files). SSI directives and IE conditional comments stay. Ignored for apk / ios.

buildMeta.description: Web builds: the build meta (<meta name="x-build">) written into index.html. gen (default true) adds gen (nx-polystack@<version>), ng and nx to its payload; set false to leave them out.

gen.description: Write the tool and its versions into the build meta.
